008package paint.viewer.model;
009
010import paint.shared.io.ExperimentDataLoader;
011import paint.shared.objects.Experiment;
012import paint.shared.objects.Project;
013import paint.shared.objects.Recording;
014import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
015
016import java.nio.file.Files;
017import java.nio.file.Path;
018import java.util.ArrayList;
019import java.util.Iterator;
020import java.util.List;
021
022/**
023 * Loads and validates {@link RecordingEntry} objects for a full PAINT project.
024 *
025 * <p>The loader ensures:</p>
026 * <ul>
027 *   <li>Each recording has its process flag set.</li>
028 *   <li>Required TrackMate and Brightfield images exist.</li>
029 *   <li>Square data is loaded via {@link ExperimentDataLoader}.</li>
030 * </ul>
031 *
032 * <p>Invalid or incomplete recordings are skipped, and diagnostic messages are
033 * logged via {@link PaintLogger}. Returned entries are ready for direct use in
034 * the PAINT viewer.</p>
035 */
036public class RecordingLoader {
037
038    /**
039     * Loads all valid {@link RecordingEntry} objects from a project.
040     *
041     * @param project the project containing experiment directories and metadata
042     * @return list of validated {@link RecordingEntry} objects; empty if none valid
043     */
044    public static List<RecordingEntry> loadFromProject(Project project) {
045
046        List<RecordingEntry> recordingEntries = new ArrayList<>();
047
048        for (String experimentName : project.getExperimentNames()) {
049
050            Path experimentPath = project.getProjectRootPath().resolve(experimentName);
051
052            // ------------------------------------------------------------------
053            // Load full experiment (squares only; tracks intentionally disabled)
054            // ------------------------------------------------------------------
055            Experiment experiment = ExperimentDataLoader.loadExperiment(
056                    project.getProjectRootPath(),
057                    experimentName,
058                    true,   // load squares
059                    false   // do not load tracks
060            );
061
062            if (experiment == null || experiment.getRecordings().isEmpty()) {
063                PaintLogger.warnf("Experiment '%s' contains no valid recordings.", experimentName);
064                continue;
065            }
066
067            for (Recording recording : experiment.getRecordings()) {
068
069                String recordingName = recording.getRecordingName();
070
071                // Skip recordings not flagged for processing
072                if (!recording.isProcessFlagSet()) {
073                    continue;
074                }
075
076                // ------------------------------------------------------------------
077                // TrackMate image (*.jpg)
078                // ------------------------------------------------------------------
079                Path trackmateImagePath = experimentPath
080                        .resolve("TrackMate Images")
081                        .resolve(recordingName + ".jpg");
082
083                if (!Files.exists(trackmateImagePath)) {
084                    PaintLogger.errorf(
085                            "Missing TrackMate image for recording '%s' (%s)",
086                            recordingName, trackmateImagePath
087                    );
088                    continue;
089                }
090
091                // ------------------------------------------------------------------
092                // Brightfield images (recording*.jpg or recording-BF*.jpg)
093                // ------------------------------------------------------------------
094                Path brightfieldDirPath = experimentPath.resolve("Brightfield Images");
095
096                if (!Files.isDirectory(brightfieldDirPath)) {
097                    PaintLogger.errorf(
098                            "Missing Brightfield directory '%s' for recording '%s'",
099                            brightfieldDirPath, recordingName
100                    );
101                    continue;
102                }
103
104                Path brightfieldImagePath = null;
105
106                try (java.util.stream.Stream<Path> stream = Files.list(brightfieldDirPath)) {
107                    for (Iterator<Path> it = stream.iterator(); it.hasNext(); ) {
108                        Path p = it.next();
109                        String fileName = p.getFileName().toString();
110
111                        // Match "<recording name>.jpg", "<recording name>-BF.jpg" and similar.
112                        //
113                        // The name must not be followed by a digit: recording names end in a
114                        // number, so a plain startsWith() lets recording "…-A4-1" match the file
115                        // of "…-A4-10" and display the wrong brightfield image. (The old
116                        // "-BF" clause here was dead: startsWith(name + "-BF") can only be true
117                        // when startsWith(name) already is.)
118                        boolean isMatch = false;
119                        if (fileName.endsWith(".jpg") && fileName.startsWith(recordingName)) {
120                            String rest = fileName.substring(recordingName.length());
121                            isMatch = rest.isEmpty() || !Character.isDigit(rest.charAt(0));
122                        }
123
124                        if (isMatch) {
125                            brightfieldImagePath = p;
126                            break;
127                        }
128                    }
129                } catch (Exception e) {
130                    PaintLogger.errorf("Error scanning Brightfield directory: %s", e.getMessage());
131                }
132
133                if (brightfieldImagePath == null) {
134                    PaintLogger.warnf("Missing Brightfield image for recording '%s'", recordingName);
135                    continue;
136                }
137
138                // ------------------------------------------------------------------
139                // Construct final entry
140                // ------------------------------------------------------------------
141                RecordingEntry entry = new RecordingEntry(
142                        recording,
143                        trackmateImagePath,
144                        brightfieldImagePath,
145                        experimentName
146                );
147
148                recordingEntries.add(entry);
149            }
150        }
151
152        return recordingEntries;
153    }
154}
